description: Radial layout with an outer ring of evenly spaced circles, a surrounding jagged boundary connected by radial spokes, and a small cluster of circles near the center. Dashed inner circle is ignored as a guide.

components.description: Outer annular band containing multiple medium-sized circular marks evenly distributed around the full 360 degrees, forming a ring.
Thin radial spokes connecting the outer-ring circles to a jagged closed polyline that traces around the exterior; includes the outer polygonal perimeter line.
Small cluster of circular marks scattered near the center region.

primary.explanation: Outer ring of 16 circles evenly spaced around 360 degrees at a fixed radius within the annulus.
One radial spoke per outer-ring circle, evenly spaced around 360°.
Five small inner circles scattered near the center within radius 0–0.32
One perimeter vertex per spoke, using its shared endpoint radius.
